resources.string: Namaz Akışı: Ekibaddewo mu kiseera ky’esswala
Entegeka eno egattibwako okuva mu app ya automation
Browser tezisobola kufuna lukusa lwa lubeerera. Gigatteko okuva ku lukalala lwa plugin mu app nga Tasker, MacroDroid oba Automate.
Gigatteko ng’olonda “Namaz Akışı” ku lukalala lwa plugin mu app nga Tasker, MacroDroid oba Automate.
Wagaana dda app eno okuteeka akabonero ku sswala zo. Osobola okugikkiriza mu Namaz Akışı wansi w’Entegeka > “App ezisobola okuteeka akabonero ku sswala”.

%1$s esobola okumanya ekiseera ky’esswala lwe kituuka, lwe kinaatera okuggwaako, ne bw’oba oli ku muzikiti, n’ekola automation zo. Osobola okukyusa ky’osazeewo mu Namaz Akışı wansi w’Entegeka > “App ezisobola okuteeka akabonero ku sswala”.

%1$s esobola okuteeka akabonero ku sswala eriwo nti esaaliddwa ng’ekozesa automation gy’oteeseteese. Osobola okukyusa ky’osazeewo mu Namaz Akışı wansi w’Entegeka > “App ezisobola okuteeka akabonero ku sswala”.
